title: Reconnect With Your Body | Somatic Movement Meditation for Safety & Self-Ownership

method.teacher_system: The teacher guides the learner to sit comfortably, center with deep breathing, and then move gently while listening to bodily sensations.
method.signature: Inviting the learner to listen to internal stories and emotions through intuitive movement.

practices.what: Find a comfortable position, sitting or laying down, and take three deep breaths into the belly.

beliefs.belief: Your body is yours, not society's, and you live in it 24/7.

feelings.response: Acknowledge the feeling of numbness or being a stranger in your own skin as a common disconnect.

struggles.theme: Feeling sad or dealing with trapped emotions and grief
Feeling disconnected from the body for a long time
Feeling awkward while trying to follow along

clicked.theme: Voice was gentle and calming, making it easy to connect
Allowed release of tension, tears, and heavy emotions

requests.theme: Asking for a version without background music

meant.theme: Felt safe, free, energized, and deeply at peace

method.limits: The video focuses entirely on seated somatic meditation and internal body awareness, showing no standing choreography or technical footwork.
